question: Which ethnic group is the largest in China, accounting for over 90% of the population?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Han**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Han ethnic group** is the largest ethnic group in **China**, accounting for over **90% of the population**.
 
• The Han people are one of the oldest continuous civilizations, with their origins tracing back to ancient China.
 
• The Han culture has had a significant influence on Chinese history, language, and traditions, making it central to the identity of China.
 
• The **Mandarin language**, which is the official language of China, is derived from the Han ethnic group's linguistic heritage.
 
• Han ethnicity is not confined to China alone; there are significant populations in other regions, including **Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau**, and various Southeast Asian countries.
 
• The Han people have a rich cultural heritage, including contributions to **philosophy, literature, art, medicine, and scientific discoveries**.
 
• Ancient dynasties such as the **Han Dynasty**, which lasted from 206 BCE to 220 CE, played a major role in shaping the political, social, and economic systems of China.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Uighur**__

 __
 
• The **Uighurs** are a Turkic ethnic group native to the **Xinjiang region** of northwest China.
 
• They are predominantly **Muslim** and have a distinct culture, language, and traditions.
 
• The Uighurs are a minority ethnic group in China, and their population is significantly smaller compared to the Han population.
 
 
 
• **Zhuang**__
 __
 
• The **Zhuang** people are primarily found in the **Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region** and neighboring provinces of China.
 
• They are the **largest minority ethnic group** in China, with a rich cultural heritage and distinct language belonging to the Tai-Kadai language family.
 
 
 
• **Manchu**__
 
 
• The **Manchu** ethnic group originates from northeastern China, historically known as **Manchuria**.
 
• The Manchus established the **Qing Dynasty**, which ruled China from 1644 to 1912.
 
• Their population is relatively small compared to the Han ethnicity.
